title.zh: 修订第1001号法案，规定阿布拉省新设La Paz市镇的市镇政府所在地设于原La Paz市镇的法案
title.en: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NUMBERED ONE THOUSAND AND ONE SO AS TO PROVIDE THAT THE SEAT OF MUNICIPAL GOVERNMENT OF THE NEW MUNICIPALITY OF LA PAZ, PROVINCE OF ABRA, SHALL BE AT THE FORMER MUNICIPALITY OF LA PAZ.
title.orig: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NUMBERED ONE THOUSAND AND ONE SO AS TO PROVIDE THAT THE SEAT OF MUNICIPAL GOVERNMENT OF THE NEW MUNICIPALITY OF LA PAZ, PROVINCE OF ABRA, SHALL BE AT THE FORMER MUNICIPALITY OF LA PAZ.
title.vi: Luật sửa đổi Đạo luật số 1001, quy định trụ sở chính quyền đô thị mới La Paz, tỉnh Abra, đặt tại đô thị La Paz trước đây
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขกฎหมายเลขที่ 1001 กำหนดให้ที่ตั้งรัฐบาลเทศบาล La Paz แห่งใหม่ จังหวัด Abra อยู่ ณ เทศบาล La Paz เดิม
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Undang-Undang Nomor 1001, menetapkan pusat pemerintahan munisipalitas baru La Paz, Provinsi Abra, berada di munisipalitas La Paz yang lama
title.ms: Akta meminda Akta No. 1001, menetapkan pusat kerajaan perbandaran baharu La Paz, wilayah Abra, di perbandaran La Paz yang terdahulu

text.en:
Paragraph four of section one of Act Numbered One thousand and one is hereby amended by
striking out at the end of said paragraph the words "at the barrio of Toon, now a part of the municipality of
La Paz," and inserting in lieu thereof the words "at the present municipality of La Paz."

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, July 26, 1904.
